author: Daksha1611
title: LLM accuracy GPU tests fail with HuggingFace 429 rate limit on model download
signature: 429 Too Many Requests you have reached your api rate limit|External Service

failed_jobs.name: LLM accuracy iGPU tests / LLM accuracy GPU tests
failed_jobs.symptom: 2 of 4 accuracy_conformance tests for TinyLlama-1.1B-Chat-v1.0 (INT8/INT4-GPU) failed with huggingface_hub.errors.HfHubHTTPError: 429 Too Many Requests while listing repo files on huggingface.co

key_errors:
huggingface_hub.errors.HfHubHTTPError: (Request ID: Root=1-6aea2461-3326e86e27f2d57e5e86aa98;301b95d3-bc75-4574-a3a0-1307f5659a18)
429 Too Many Requests: you have reached your 'api' rate limit.
Retry after 29 seconds (0/3000 requests remaining in current 300s window).
Url: https://huggingface.co/api/models/TinyLlama/TinyLlama-1.1B-Chat-v1.0/tree/fe8a4ea1ffedaf415f4da2f062534de366a451e6?recursive=true&expand=false.
We had to rate limit you, you hit the quota of 3000 api requests per 5 minutes period.
root_cause: The LLM accuracy GPU test job calls optimum's TasksManager.get_model_files -> huggingface_hub.hf_api.list_repo_files/list_repo_tree to enumerate TinyLlama-1.1B-Chat-v1.0 files before export, since no cached OpenVINO IR was found locally. HuggingFace Hub returned HTTP 429 (team-plan quota of 3000 API requests per 5-minute window exhausted), which is a third-party rate limit unrelated to the PR under test (tools/benchmark_tool argument-parsing fix). This is the 4th recorded occurrence of this exact signature since 2026-08-27, confirming it is a recurring upstream-capacity issue rather than a regression caused by this PR.
reproduction_steps: N/A - depends on HuggingFace Hub's shared API rate-limit window at the time of the CI run; not deterministically reproducible locally.
recommended_actions: Re-run the failed 'LLM accuracy iGPU tests' job; this clears once the 5-minute HF Hub rate-limit window resets.
Consider caching converted OpenVINO IR models for TinyLlama-1.1B-Chat-v1.0 across merge-queue runs to avoid repeated huggingface_hub.list_repo_files calls.
Consider setting HF_HUB_OFFLINE/local cache reuse or an HF token with a higher quota tier for CI jobs that run frequently in the merge queue.
prevention_strategies: Add local model/IR caching (e.g., actions/cache keyed on model id+revision) so LLM accuracy jobs do not re-query huggingface_hub.list_repo_files on every merge-queue run, and consider a shared, authenticated HF token with a higher per-5-minute quota for CI.
